materials.title: Recordings described as 'refer to the course website'
Assignments described as 'refer to the course website'

blocked.reason: The snapshot supplies only a direction to consult the website; it contains no assignment title, prompt, term, ordering, files, or stable assignment URL.
This normalized record has no URL and is not sufficient to identify a lecture or recording.
The catalog praises a textbook but does not provide its title, edition, license, or locator; no textbook content was inferred or obtained.
The snapshot does not contain an official schedule or a verified mapping from topics and links to concrete ordered course units.

retrieval_policy.kickoff_dependency_policy: The kickoff must remain completable from local learner-safe material and standard Python 3.11; linked or blocked materials are not prerequisites.
retrieval_policy.later_jobs_may_retrieve: Only an explicitly authorized retrieval job may access public locators.
later_job_requirements: Preserve the source record and requested URL
Record retrieval outcome, final locator, timestamp, content hash, and license or access terms when known
Classify the retrieved object before adding any unit or dependency edge
Verify concrete title, term or version, ordering, and official status instead of inferring them from link position
Keep unavailable and failed retrieval records rather than rewriting them as available
retrieval_policy.restricted_content: Do not bypass authentication, paywalls, robots controls, access restrictions, or license limits. Do not retrieve hidden graders, sealed references, solutions, or private student work.
retrieval_policy.promotion_rule: A link, description, or official-course-unit flag alone never promotes a record to an official runnable unit.
